policy.scope: Greater Melbourne councils first; regional councils are onboarded only after a separate regional vacancy benchmark is approved.
policy.publicationRule: A planning application count is not a dwelling count unless the source reports dwelling quantity or a reviewed parser extracts it with an explicit inferred flag.

sources.retrieval: Public statutory register supports a date-range report and CSV export after accepting the published terms. Exact duplicate report rows must be removed before aggregation.
sources.limitation: The annual registered-applications report does not expose a reliable current status for every row. Publish aggregate suburb results only; do not retain officer fields, republish record-level addresses or use personal information for direct marketing.
Dwelling quantities may need reviewed extraction from descriptions.

sources.retrieval: Public ASP.NET register supports date-range search and session-scoped pagination through EnquirySummaryView.aspx?PageNumber=N. No account or access-control bypass is required.
sources.limitation: No first-party CSV/API export is exposed. HTML pagination must be rate-limited, source-dated and schema-checked. Application suffixes such as /A and /B are amendments and must be grouped with the base application. Schedules are decision lists and remain reconciliation evidence rather than a summable lodged-application feed. Description-derived dwelling yield must retain an inferred flag; unstated yields stay null.
